name: Arsi University
distanceNote: A relatively accessible southeastern trip, roughly two to three hours from Addis.
knownFor: Sitting in a major Arsi highland town with a real, established local community around it
A shorter distance from Addis than most regional universities, making it a genuinely practical option
Growing health science and agriculture programs
whatToExpect: Because Arsi University is relatively new, having only reached full university status in 2014, some programs are still building out their full reputation and facilities, ask current students in your specific department for an honest, current picture.
The cool Arsi highland climate means jackets are a regular part of daily wear, especially in the mornings and evenings.
The relatively short distance from Addis means many students from central Ethiopia find family visits genuinely manageable, this is a real, practical advantage over more remote placements.
Health science students should ask specifically about clinical attachment sites, as this is one of the newer and still developing parts of the university's program offerings.

The university runs across four sites. Dinsho, at the entrance to Asella, covers competition-based and natural science fields. Ardu, a short ride from the main transit hub, hosts upper-year students in law, accounting, and marketing along with agriculture students. Bekoji, in its own town, covers social science fields. A temporary health campus operates out of a teachers' college building for health officer, midwifery, and nursing students, while medicine students currently study through Asella's hospital directly, with a dedicated new health campus reportedly planned that would also bring engineering to Arsi for the first time.
Fresh female students are housed in dorms kept separate from continuing students specifically for safety and to reduce disruption
tips: If you are in health sciences, ask directly and early about where clinical attachments actually happen, this varies and is still being built out.
Pack warm clothes for the cool Arsi highland climate, especially for morning classes.
studentFit: Arsi University suits students who want a highland Oromia university experience without traveling extremely far from Addis, and who are comfortable with a still growing, relatively young institution. It fits people who value practical proximity to family alongside genuine highland town life. Students seeking a long established, fully mature program in a specific specialized field may find some departments here still in active development.
strengths: Sitting in a major Arsi highland town with a real, established local community around it
A shorter distance from Addis than most regional universities, making it a genuinely practical option
Growing health science and agriculture programs
